playstyle: Fundamentally sound with explosive damage. Wavu stresses he is more than a damage machine: win with solid pokes and punishes, then turn a single read into a huge combo or a Phoenix Smasher. His moves track poorly, especially to his right, so time your attacks instead of throwing them out.
